mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT MK.MODULE_ID, MK.MOUDLE_MC, MK.MOUDLE_PATH, MK.MOUDLE_SORT, MK.MOUDLE_IMAGE_TYPE, MK.DEL_FLAG, MK.CREATE_TIME, MK.CREATE_USER, MK.UPDATE_TIME, MK.UPDATE_USER FROM dataflowdb.DIC_USER U INNER JOIN dataflowdb.DIC_USER_CHARGE GX ON U.ID = GX.USER_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.sys_role_detail QXMX ON GX.ROLE_ID = QXMX.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.MENU CD ON QXMX.MENU_ID = CD.ID INNER JOIN dataflowdb.SYS_MODULE MK ON CD.MODULE_ID = MK.MODULE_ID AND CD.DELFLAG = '0' AND CD.MENU_LV = '1' AND U.ID = #{userId} ORDER BY MK.MOUDLE_SORT
